terbaru.judul: ICBAC: an Intelligent Contract-Based Access Control framework for supply chain management by integrating blockchain and federated learning
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper addresses the critical challenge of access control in modern supply chains, which operate across multiple independent and competing organizations.

terbaru.judul: Wireless Streamlet: A Spectrum-Aware and Cognitive Consensus Protocol for Edge IoT
terbaru.pelajaran: Building on Streamlet's streamlined structure, we introduce a \textit{Channel-Aware Leader Election (CALE)} mechanism.

terbaru.judul: LTRAS: A Linkable Threshold Ring Adaptor Signature Scheme for Efficient and Private Cross-Chain Transactions
terbaru.pelajaran: To address these limitations, we propose a Linkable Threshold Ring Adaptor Signature (LTRAS) scheme, which integrates the conditional binding of adaptor signatures, the multi-account payment of threshold ring signatures, and the linkability for preventing double-spending.

terbaru.judul: Blockchain Federated Learning for Sustainable Retail: Reducing Waste through Collaborative Demand Forecasting
terbaru.pelajaran: Subsequently, we introduce a Blockchain-based FL model, trained collaboratively across multiple retailers without direct data sharing.

terbaru.judul: Provenance Verification of AI-Generated Images via a Perceptual Hash Registry Anchored on Blockchain
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper proposes a blockchain-backed framework for verifying AI-generated images through a registry-based provenance mechanism.

terbaru.judul: TxRay: Agentic Postmortem of Live Blockchain Attacks
terbaru.pelajaran: We present TxRay, a Large Language Model (LLM) agentic postmortem system that uses tool calls to reconstruct live ACT attacks from limited evidence.

terbaru.judul: MultiChain Blockchain Data Provenance for Deterministic Stream Processing with Kafka Streams: A Weather Data Case Study
terbaru.pelajaran: In this work, we introduce a blockchain-backed provenance architecture for streaming platform (e.g Kafka Streams) the publishes cryptographic data of a windowed data stream without publishing window payloads on-chain.

terbaru.judul: From Transactions to Exploits: Automated PoC Synthesis for Real-World DeFi Attacks
terbaru.pelajaran: In this work, we present the first automated framework for synthesizing verifiable PoCs directly from on-chain attack executions.

terbaru.judul: Blockchain-Based Spectrum Resource Securitization via Semi-Fungible Token-Lock
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper proposes the Semi Fungible Token Lock (SFT Lock) method, a lock/unlock based mechanism that preserves NFT identity and historical traceability while enabling fractional ownership and transferability.

terbaru.judul: Know Your Contract: eIDAS-Based Verifiable Legal Identities for Smart Contracts, Enabling Regulatory-Compliant On-Chain Operations
terbaru.pelajaran: We present KYC Seal, the first protocol that extends the EU eIDAS trust infrastructure to Ethereum smart contracts by cryptographically binding them to Qualified Electronic Seals issued by Qualified Trust Service Providers (QTSPs).
